decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts reflect substantial R&D and EU-project investment and fit squarely with the firm's announced push into multifunctional packaging wafers, so any slow uptake would be read as a temporary ramp-up problem and the product kept.

The carrier wafer was publicly announced in a press release, extends the firm's core carrier and thin-wafer-handling business, and costs little to maintain, so management would stay committed to it as part of its stated direction toward reusable carriers.
